subject: Launchpad cohort: conditional top-up & billing structure (NeuraForge)
messages:
From: Ari Sethi <ari@neuraforge.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Launchpad cohort — request for conditional top-up and flexible billing

Hi Karthik / Ben,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week. NeuraForge is excited about joining the next Launchpad cohort and we'd like to propose a promotional structure that helps our team pilot at scale while preserving runway. High level ask: a milestone-triggered credit top-up and a short deferred-billing window tied to proof-of-value.

What we hope for (rough):
- Initial promo credit: $30k applied on day 1 of onboarding
- Milestone top-up: up to an additional $40k released in tranches when we hit agreed KPIs (example: 60% feature adoption within 90 days; 3 successful integrations with customer data pipelines; 2 enterprise POC sessions)
- Billing: defer invoices related to the top-up until 60 days after the top-up tranche is released (to give our CFO time to reconcile the POC)

We appreciate that this is a non-standard ask; we are open to trade-offs (longer commitment, conversion to dedicated capacity, or a smaller top-up) if you can support the runway. Attached is a short proposal with adoption metrics and proposed measurement windows.

Would you be available for a 30-minute call Tuesday to sketch the mechanics?

Best,
Ari
Co-founder, NeuraForge Labs
attachments: NeuraForge_MAProposal_v2.pdf

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Sethi <ari@neuraforge.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Launchpad cohort — request for conditional top-up and flexible billing

Hi Ari — thanks for the clear ask and the proposal doc.

We can support a conditional top-up structure but need to pin a few operational guards so it works for both teams. Proposed terms from Redwood: 

1) Initial onboarding credit: $30,000 applied on day 1.
2) Milestone top-up: up to $40,000 released in two tranches ($20k after KPI window 1, $20k after KPI window 2). KPI definitions need to be mutually agreed and measurable from logs (we'll provide the measurement dashboard).
3) Billing hold: invoices tied to the top-up will be issued at time of usage but marked with a 60-day hold period. If milestones are not met within the measurement window, remaining hold is converted to a credit reversal — this protects our revenue recognition.
4) Contract term: 12 months from onboarding date. If NeuraForge converts to Dedicated within 12 months, we'll apply a 20% conversion credit on any unused promo balance.
5) Usage cap: initial soft cap of $10k/month over promotion for first 3 months (we'll alert at 75% usage). Overage rates standard.

Action items: 
- Ben to confirm pricing/legal tradeoffs and whether we can stretch the 60-day hold to 90 if necessary.
- Laura to confirm invoicing & accounting impact.
- Ari to confirm acceptance of KPI definitions and provide a finance contact for the PO.

Happy to take this to a quick call — otherwise we can exchange a short redline and DocuSign.

-Karthik
Head of GTM, Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Sethi <ari@neuraforge.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T12:25:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Launchpad cohort — request for conditional top-up and flexible billing

Ari — great to meet the NeuraForge team last week. Quick commercial options from Sales side:

Option A (preferred): follow Karthik's structure but make the measurement windows quarterly and release $10k per quarter for 4 quarters (smoother cashflow). Billing hold remains 60 days after tranche release. In exchange we ask for a 12-month minimum consumption cadence (soft commit).

Option B (alternate): instead of a hold, issue milestone invoices with Net-30 and provide a credit memo if milestones fail. This keeps our AR clean but still gives you runway.

If you can give me the finance contact, I’ll draft the short addendum and we can route to legal. Also happy to jump on the Tuesday call.

Cheers,
Ben
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ari Sethi <ari@neuraforge.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T09:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Launchpad cohort — request for conditional top-up and flexible billing (finance constraints)

Team / Ari —

Couple of finance notes so we don't end up with a recognition problem: 

- We cannot carry indefinite deferred revenue holds tied to subjective milestones. We can accept a 60–90 day invoice hold tied to demonstrable POC completion. Alternatively, milestone invoices + credit memos (Ben's Option B) is preferred from an audit perspective.
- We'll need NeuraForge's legal entity name, billing address, and a PO number before we push any credits.
- For international entities we also need tax forms (W-9/W-8).
- If you want the quarterly release approach, we'll need clear KPIs and an automated measurement feed (we'll provide a CSV/dash link) — manual attestations won't pass our audit.

I've attached a draft top-up T&Cs (NeuraForge_Topup_T&Cs_v1.pdf) with suggested language on measurement and credit reversals. Please review and send back redlines.

-Laura
Director, Finance Ops, Redwood Inference
attachments: NeuraForge_Topup_T&Cs_v1.pdf

Subject: Re: Launchpad cohort — conditional top-up & billing structure (NeuraForge)

Thanks Laura — helpful framing. Quick replies inline below.

On Tue, Dec 1, 2026 at 11:03 AM karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> We can support a conditional top-up structure but need to pin a few operational guards so it works for both teams. Proposed terms from Redwood: 
> ...

We are aligned on most points. A few asks from our side: 
- Instead of a one-time tranche release, can the top-up be quarterly ($10k per quarter for up to 4 quarters) tied to the same KPI set? That helps us plan cash and expectation.
- For the billing hold: can you accept an "invoice hold until POC completion" clause that is operationally equivalent to a 60-day hold but triggered by milestone sign-off? Our finance lead is Sonia Patel (finance@neuraforge.com) — she can issue the PO.
- We will accept the automated measurement feed — our engineers can integrate a simple CSV export into your dashboard.

Attaching a single-page redline (one page) with the small language tweaks and Sonia's contact. If we can get acceptance on the DocuSign by end of next week we can start onboarding on 2027-01-04.

Thanks — Ari
Co-founder, NeuraForge Labs

Ari — thanks, this is actionable and I think we have a path forward. Summary of agreed commercial terms (to confirm):

- Initial credit: $30k on day 1 of onboarding.
- Quarterly top-up: $10k per quarter for up to 4 quarters (total additional $40k), released upon automated KPI verification.
- Invoice handling: Redwood will issue invoices at time of usage. Invoices related to top-up will be placed on an "invoice hold until POC completion" and cleared within 60 days of sign-off by Sonia Patel. If milestones are not met, any unreleased top-up tranches will be reversed per T&Cs.
- Contract term: 12 months. 20% conversion credit to Dedicated if you convert within the first 12 months.
- We require PO/Entity/tax forms before activation; Sonia to send PO to finance@redwood.ai.
- Next step: Ben will send the short addendum; Laura will confirm final invoicing language; I'll share the DocuSign link once legal signs off. Target: onboard 2027-01-04.

Ben/Laura/grace — please proceed to prepare the addendum and routing for signatures. Ari — we'll send the DocuSign link by end of day Monday if all internal approvals come through.

Thanks — looking forward to getting NeuraForge into the cohort.

-Karthik
